description: A node to generate various composite cloud noises
name: Clouds

inputs.description: The input image or atlas of 4 or 16 input images
inputs.name: in

inputs.description: The mask applied to the pattern
inputs.name: mask

instance: vec4 tiler_$(name)(vec2 uv, vec2 tile, int overlap, inout vec3 instance_uv, vec2 _seed, float _seed_variation_, vec4 _controlled_variation_) {
vec2 pos = uv*tile+vec2(float(dx), float(dy)); pos = fract((floor(mod(pos, tile))+vec2(0.5))/tile)-vec2(0.5);
instance_uv = mix(instance_uv, vec3(full_uv, uv_rand), step(c, c1));
